title: Sahib Rai, the Horses, and the Search for Tara Singh

blocks.text: The dispute sharpens around Sahib Rai, a local chaudhari whose grievance over horses and village influence becomes the pretext for escalating pressure on the Singhs.

The page notes that sahib rai bada chaudharî hutó and that dui ghôrdî us ghar thi changî, then moves into accusation and retaliation as the chaudhari and the Singhs trade hard words over honour and theft.
From there the narrative turns toward search and concealment, with tau chaudhari kahi singhan uchâra and hamrç dçhu tân chôr phardâi marking the moment when private hostility becomes public pursuit.
